name: part-suppression-on-published-api
description: A suppression record for an unused parameter of a library's published function or method is in effect at the default minimum confidence, because a part's finding carries its own class rather than the class of the published declaration that holds it. Each mechanism holds it: a directive above the function, a trailing directive on its first line, a directive trailing a parameter of a wrapped signature, and an ignore entry carrying the finding's own reference and path. One record holds every unused parameter of its function, and a record on a function whose parameters are all read is stale.
